result.Method of Attack: Injected malicious module that stole cryptocurrency by redirecting transactions to attacker-controlled wallet addresses; Crypto-jacking by hooking Ethereum and Solana signing requests and swapping wallet addresses
result.Discoverer: Open-source software community, Wiz, Security Alliance
result.Impacted Systems: JavaScript/Node projects, Cloud environments (approx. 10% during attack window)
result.Attack Vector: Phishing attack via password reset lure on maintainer Josh Junon's (qix) account
result.Indicators of Compromise: Malicious package versions available on npm for 2 hours; Malicious code reached 1 in 10 cloud environments; Attacker-controlled wallet addresses flagged and tracked
